correctness.rationale: Precise cover counts and n! normalization follow from canonical order-polytope triangulations. Two divergence-field calculations establish exact metric area and mean-one identities. Contracted-edge multipoint integrals are represented by identity substitutions in alternating bounded Volterra factors. The norm bound (4) controls exceptional tuples, and rank-one K=UD spectral mixing with eigenvalue ratio 1:9 establishes each fixed factorial moment tends to 1. Exact DP checks n=2..17 and elementary analytic eigenvalue calculations support the proof. The full Poisson limit is a theorem rather than finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: A random linear extension of a highly constrained alternating poset exhibits a nondegenerate universal Poisson law for its rigid cover contacts, despite the exact finite expectation and deterministic upper bound. The result connects codimension-one Euclidean order-polytope geometry with the entire hierarchy of correlated face-contact events; it is not obtained by the known volume count or a routine rescaling. The complete limit law is a natural invariant for this extensively studied infinite family.
